fields.label: SNMG (Minimum Wage Floor)
fields.description: Salaire National Minimum Général — minimum monthly wage floor in DZD. Gross salaries below this produce a non-blocking warning.

fields.label: CNAS Employee Rate
fields.description: Employee CNAS contribution rate as a percentage of gross salary. Default 9%.

fields.label: CNAS Employer Rate
fields.description: Employer CNAS contribution rate as a percentage of gross salary. Default 26%.

fields.label: IRG Bracket 1 Limit
fields.description: Upper bound of the 0% IRG band (DZD).

fields.label: IRG Bracket 1 Rate
fields.description: Income tax rate (%) for the 0% band — 0 to 30,000 DZD.

fields.label: IRG Bracket 2 Limit
fields.description: Upper bound of the 23% IRG band (DZD).

fields.label: IRG Bracket 2 Rate
fields.description: Income tax rate (%) for the 23% band — 30,001 to 120,000 DZD.

fields.label: IRG Bracket 3 Limit
fields.description: Upper bound of the 27% IRG band (DZD).

fields.label: IRG Bracket 3 Rate
fields.description: Income tax rate (%) for the 27% band — 120,001 to 360,000 DZD.

fields.label: IRG Bracket 4 Rate
fields.description: Income tax rate (%) for the top bracket — above 360,000 DZD.

fields.label: Professional Expense Abatement Rate
fields.description: Professional expense abatement as a percentage of net social. Default 40%.

fields.label: Abatement Minimum
fields.description: Floor for the professional expense abatement (DZD). Narrow-band smoothing only — see code comment in payroll.ts. Not applied to match the official worked example.

fields.label: Abatement Maximum
fields.description: Ceiling for the professional expense abatement (DZD). Narrow-band smoothing only — see code comment in payroll.ts. Not applied to match the official worked example.
